hookups.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/promised-land-state-park/stay ('Campgrounds vary from rustic ... to full hookup (sewer, electric, and water hookup on site)') + ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880414 (every one of the 197 electric sites lists 50-amp; the 30 Full-Hookup sites in Northwoods and Pickerel Point list water and sewer), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Six camping areas; 368 campsites on the booking site besides 6 equestrian sites, cabins, cottages and glamping: Lower Lake Campground's Beechwood (101 electric), Northwoods (28 electric, 18 full-hookup), Rhododendron (15 electric, 45 non-electric); Pickerel Point (23 electric, 12 full-hookup, 38 walk-to tent sites); Deerfield (32 rustic non-electric) and Pines (56 rustic non-electric). Listed max vehicle lengths run mostly 20-50 ft, to 60 ft at Northwoods and Deerfield; four Beechwood pull-throughs list 100 ft and one Rhododendron site 130 ft, left out of max_rig_ft as likely driveway figures. About 14 pull-throughs.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/promised-land-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880414 (site list and each site's details page: Max Vehicle Length, driveway entry, site access) + the DCNR stay page (area-by-area site counts), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Beechwood, Northwoods and Pickerel Point have warm showers and laundry; Rhododendron has showers; Deerfield and Pines are rustic (flush toilets, no showers: Deerfield campers use Pickerel Point's showers, Pines has pay showers in the picnic area). Modern facilities in Beechwood run Memorial Day through Columbus Day. Dump station at the Lower Lake Campground entrance.

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/promised-land-state-park/stay + ReserveAmerica Services and Amenities for parkId 880414 (A Coin Laundry Is Available In The Campground, Hot Showers, Dump Station, Potable Water), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campsites can be booked up to 11 months ahead and for the same day (ReserveAmerica booking window). 'The maximum stay in all camping areas is 14 days during the summer season and 21 days during the off-season', then 48 hours away before setting up again.

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/promised-land-state-park/stay (Camping Reminders) + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/promised-land-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880414 (Booking Window: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window/14-night max for this park; year-round season (limited Pickerel Point sites) already manual and matches DCNR. Added 50-amp electric with water+sewer at 30 full-hookup sites, 368 campsites across six areas to ~60 ft with pull-throughs, showers, flush toilets, laundry, potable water, dump. The $16 rustic base stands: Pines and Deerfield rustic sites are drive-in, many listed 25-60 ft. Not stated: Saturday 2-night minimum (left inherited), noon cutoff, fcfs. Fees left as recorded.
